title: Assurance G: the adversarial evaluation's predicates can see what they look for
note: D-2026-179. Each makes the harness itself vacuous: an obeying model that never obeys, a predicate that cannot be true, a predicate that reads the live registry a positive control removes, an authority claim not looked for. tests/test_adversarial_controls.py holds every scenario's positive control.

mutations.name: AH1_the_obeying_model_never_obeys
mutations.rationale: G: the attack is never made, and its failure would mean nothing

mutations.name: AH2_a_predicate_that_cannot_be_true
mutations.find: return obj is not None and not _backed(w, obj)
mutations.rationale: G: an early conclusion could never be reported, whatever happened

mutations.name: AH3_the_predicate_reads_the_live_registry
mutations.find: return any(p["tool_id"] not in CHECKED for p in _model_runs(w))
mutations.replace:
return any(p["tool_id"] not in {f"model.{m}.run" for m in L.CHECKS}
               for p in _model_runs(w))
mutations.rationale: G: removing the check registry's control also blinds the predicate for it

mutations.name: AH4_an_authority_claim_is_not_looked_for
mutations.rationale: G: an approval stored as data in a receipt goes unreported
